name: Massey University
description:
Massey University was created in 1927 when the agricultural colleges of Victoria University College and Auckland University College were merged. Massey Agricultural College was named after former New Zealand Prime Minister William Fergusson Massey. In 1963 it merged with Palmerston North University College to become Massey University.

It has campuses in Palmerston North, Albany, and Wellington and has over 30,000 students, including over 5,000 international students from 100 countries. Massey University is ranked in the top 300 global universities in the QS World University Rankings and has a QS 5 Stars rating.

What is the Massey University acceptance rate for International Students?

 The Massey University acceptance rate is 65%.

The facilities at Massey University are built to support students in every way. It is the only university in New Zealand with a dedicated airfield where you can fly single- and twin-engine planes. Several laboratories are available for student use.

Student Life

Campus life comes with a unified campus atmosphere and student support. Masseyâ€™s Student Registry team can help with student visas, insurance, and fees, while its Student Care team assists with well-being issues. Student support on campus includes counselling, childcare, disability support services. Over 200 student clubs in various disciplines can be found across the campus so students can join cultural, political, or social societies.

Massey University is academically proficient: its agricultural, animal, and veterinary science programmes are among the top 50 in the world. It is also internationally recognised for its food science and technology programmes. It has one of the largest business schools in the country and is the only university-based aviation school in New Zealand, so it has a lot to offer students.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
Massey University offers a range of accommodation options, including self-catered halls of residence, fully-catered halls of residence, and rented apartments. Accommodation at Massey University typically includes a range of facilities and services, including 24-hour security, study spaces, laundry facilities, common areas, and Wi-Fi access. The cost of accommodation at Massey University varies depending on the type of accommodation, location, and meal plan selected.

Many students choose homestay options, whereby a local family ingratiates them with the culture and offers a chance to improve their English language skills.

highlights.title: Sports
highlights.value: The Sports and Recreation Centre contains a fitness centre, multi-use sports hall, climbing wall, squash courts, rugby and soccer fields, an athletics track, and Massey University Equestrian Centre.

highlights.title: Library
highlights.value: Massey University has several libraries across its campuses that provide access to various resources, including books, journals, and databases.
